reason: A DSH web plugin that adds a conversation dock showing DeepSeek account balance, with periodic host-mediated API refresh and no broader workflow or content-generation function.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话界面下方显示账户余额，并通过主机路由定期刷新余额信息。
summaries.en: Displays the DeepSeek account balance below the conversation in the DeepSeek Harness web interface and refreshes it periodically through a host route.

capabilities: Displays DeepSeek account balance in the DSH conversation interface
Calls the DeepSeek balance API through a host-side route
Polls the host balance route every 15 seconds
Reads the configured DeepSeek API credential through the host credentials service
